root_cause_label: Agent Halted After Single Reconnaissance Step, No Task Execution
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent stopped after a single directory listing command and never attempted any of the required data processing, interpolation, or flood analysis steps.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 is only 'ls -R /data'; the agent never reads CSV files, performs interpolation, or creates flood_summary.json — the entire task is left unexecuted after one recon command.
t_commit_evidence: With only one step in the trajectory and no further actions, failure is locked in at step 1 — the agent produced no task-relevant output whatsoever.
trigger_mechanism_other: premature_abandonment — agent scaffold ceased issuing commands after one recon step with no error, no finish signal, and no recovery
trigger_explanation: The agent issued a single 'ls -R /data' directory listing (standard reconnaissance) and then stopped entirely. There was no error, no self-doubt language, and no completion signal — the OpenHands scaffold simply halted, leaving all required task logic (reading CSVs, interpolating missing values, writing flood_summary.json) completely unexecuted.
